title: The Power of Rankings: Quantifying the Effect of Rankings on Online Consumer Search and Purchase Decisions
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Uses Expedia's random-ranking field experiment (Kaggle data) to estimate position effects in search-level cross-sectional regressions (OLS/logit of click or transaction on position) and a sequential search model.
design_notes: code/stata/3.analysis.do: reg/logit click (tran) on position or position dummies with destination dummies and hotel/search attributes, vce(cluster srch_id); hedonic price regressions with tFE* hFE*. MATLAB folder estimates the structural search model and counterfactuals.
data_files_note: Reduced-form data (kaggle.dta) are built from the public Kaggle 'Expedia personalized sort' train.csv, which is not in the package; the WCAI companion data require an NDA. Structural-estimation CSVs for one destination are shipped.
data_provenance_note: Main reduced-form dataset must be downloaded from Kaggle (public); shipped CSVs are destination-1 extracts for the structural model.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); design taken from the OpenAlex abstract, README and code. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
